naive.name: server_fleet_kb_search
naive.description: Runs `fleet-kb search <query>` against system-docs.db (local FTS5 documentation search).

naive.name: server_read
naive.description: Read a file. Args: path (absolute), offset (line, default 0), max_lines (default 200). Returns {ok,data,error}.

naive.name: server_read_many
naive.description: Read several files in one call. Args: paths (array of absolute paths, max 20). Returns {ok,data:[{path,ok,content|error}]}.

naive.name: server_write
naive.description: Create/overwrite a file (write-scoped: ai-stack, projects, Obsidian, .config/opencode, /tmp ...). Args: path, content. Returns {ok,data,error}.

naive.name: server_edit
naive.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. old_string must occur EXACTLY ONCE (else error, nothing written). Args: path, old_string, new_string.

naive.name: server_grep
naive.description: Search file contents (ripgrep regex). Args: pattern, path (default ai-stack), glob (optional file filter like '*.py'). Returns {ok,data:'file:line:text' lines}.

naive.name: server_glob
naive.description: Find files by glob (ripgrep). Args: pattern (e.g. '**/*.py'), path (default ai-stack). Returns {ok,data:[paths]}.

naive.name: server_bash
naive.description: Run one shell command via the omnitool. Args: command, timeout_s (default 30), cwd (optional). Returns {ok (exit 0), data:{exit_code,stdout,stderr}}.

naive.name: server_sql
naive.description: Run SQL on a fleet SQLite db. Args: database (path), query, mode ('read_only' default | 'read_write'). Returns {ok,data:rows}.

naive.name: server_web_fetch
naive.description: Fetch a URL as text. Args: url. Returns {ok,data:text}.

naive.name: server_board_query
naive.description: Query dispatch.db task queue: counts by status (staged/approved/needs_review/done), recent completions, and lane balance. Replaces manual sqlite3 queries on dispatch.db.

limit.description: Max tasks to return in summary mode

naive.name: server_fleet_exec
naive.description: Run bin/fleet-exec (the omnitool): a batch of bash/read/write/patch/sql/glob/grep operations, validated whole before anything runs. Input: {operations:[{type:'bash',command:'...'}, ...]}.

naive.name: server_embed
naive.description: Local text embeddings (no cloud): nomic-embed-text v1.5 (768-d) or BitNet-embedding-270M (640-d).

naive.name: server_ring_heads
naive.description: Query the fleet's ring heads (ring_headd): {health:true} | {heads:true} | {head, text|texts}.

naive.name: server_shard_search
naive.description: Search the fleet's memory (Claude Code sessions, the vault, stored notes): full-text + local nomic vectors, fused; every hit names its store, id and source. Input: {q, stores?:['sessions','vault','notes'], k?}.

naive.name: server_arc
naive.description: The arc reactor (ARC stage F): exact engines (every reasoning generator), independent judges, pages and receipts. Input: {op: solve|verify|catalog|page_get|page_put|address|decode|ping, ...}: solve {domain, problem? | i, seed, level} → exact trace + answer + receipt; verify {domain, problem, answer} → the judge's verdict + receipt; page_put {domain, key, text, verified:true}.

naive.name: server_shard_put
naive.description: Store a note in the shared memory any harness can search later. Input: {text, tags?, source?}.

naive.name: server_mark
naive.description: Record an app happening in the Weaver field (kind=event): {target:'<app>/<area>', outcome?, weight?, detail?}. The omniring area field reads it; evidence only, never a trigger.

naive.name: server_session_recall
naive.description: Read back a past session's messages: {session} or {q} (best-matching session), limit?.
